parts.name: Root
parts.description: State container for the autocomplete. Owns the search query, local filtering, and virtual focus, and wires the ARIA relationship between the input and the list.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable ID used to generate internal ARIA IDs (recommended for SSR).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables all user interaction.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the input focusable while preventing query and selection changes.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Current search query. Can be bound with bind:inputValue.

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description: Initial query for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: filter
props.description:
Local filter function. Defaults to a case-insensitive "contains" match.
Set to `null` to disable local filtering (e.g. when filtering server-side).

props.name: autoHighlight
props.description: Automatically highlight the first matching item as the query changes.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Called when the search query changes.

props.name: children
props.description: Composed autocomplete parts.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the root element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the autocomplete group.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the autocomplete group.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is disabled.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: Search input with role="searchbox". Keeps DOM focus while arrow keys move a virtual focus through the list via aria-activedescendant.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the input.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of element that labels this input.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of element that describes this input (e.g. usage instructions).

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the input has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the autocomplete is readonly.

parts.name: List
parts.description: The always-visible listbox of filtered options. Accepts the same selection props as ListBox.Root (selectionMode, value, defaultValue, onChange).

props.name: items
props.description: Optional items for dynamic rendering.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the list. Receives item in dynamic mode.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: How selection behaves: 'toggle' allows deselection, 'replace' always selects.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Keys of items that should be disabled and non-selectable.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Selection mode: 'single' allows one selection, 'multiple' allows many.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected keys. Two-way by default — use `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selection, for when `value` is not supplied.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Opt into fully controlled state: the component stops writing back to `value` and
only reports through `onChange`, so the parent can reject a change by not flowing
the new selection back down. Off by default, because `bind:value` — the common
case — needs the write-back to work at all.

props.name: header
props.description:
Rows rendered inside the listbox above the items — an action row such as
"Create …". Kept out of `children` because in dynamic mode that snippet is called
once per item.

A virtualized list does not navigate into it: navigation there walks the item
array, which this is not part of.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class to apply to the listbox container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the listbox. Announced by screen readers.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired when the selection changes.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether arrow-key navigation wraps from the last item to the first (and back).

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Whether typing characters moves focus to the option whose text matches.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description:
Renders only the rows near the viewport instead of all of them.

Only honoured together with `items`: the listbox has to own the loop to be able to
slice it, so a list written as static children is never virtualized.

Rows must all be the same height — that assumption is what lets the scrollbar be
sized without measuring every row. The height is measured from the first rendered
row unless `rowHeight` says otherwise, so a themed list needs no magic number.

The listbox element itself is the scroller: give it a max height and
`overflow-y: auto`, as an unvirtualized long list would need anyway.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: A selectable option inside the list. Matched against the query through its textValue and exposes selection and focus state through data attributes.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier for this item. Used for selection tracking.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text value for typeahead search. If not provided, extracted from content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this item is disabled and non-selectable.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class to apply to the item element.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render inside the item.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Override the visual pressed state. When provided, this value is used instead of internal press tracking.

parts.name: ItemIndicator
parts.description: Visual indicator rendered inside an item while it is selected. Defaults to a checkmark icon.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render when selected (defaults to a checkmark icon).

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Force the indicator to render regardless of selection state.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the indicator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "checked" while the item is selected, "unchecked" otherwise.

parts.name: Empty
parts.description: Empty state shown when no options match the current query.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to show when empty (defaults to "No results").

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class names for the empty-state element.

parts.name: Status
parts.description: Visually hidden aria-live="polite" region that announces the number of visible results to screen readers.

props.name: formatMessage
props.default:
(count: number) =>
			count === 0 ? 'No results available' : `${count} result${count === 1 ? '' : 's'} available`
props.description: Build the announced message from the visible item count.
